data.title: 芙宁娜 · 澄澈水畔假日
data.description: 【芙宁娜 · 澄澈水畔假日】远离喧嚣的枫丹隐秘海湾，阳光洒在如水晶般透亮的碧蓝浅滩上。芙宁娜轻轻挽起华美礼裙的下摆，赤足漫步在清凉的海水中，回眸朝镜头绽放出纯真无邪的笑容——「偶尔离开歌剧院，赤脚走在水里的感觉……真的好舒服呢！」
data.location: 枫丹清澈浅滩与阳光白沙
data.action: 提裙赤足踏在清澈浅水之中，回眸浅笑，水花飞溅
data.lighting: 热带清澈阳光与水底波光粼粼折射
data.camera: full body, eye level, feet and shallow waves visible
data.promptProse: Furina lifts her blue ballgown clear of the turquoise shallows and looks back with playful laughter as her bare feet send droplets outward. Frame her entire figure at eye level, including the wet hem and sand visible through the water. The shoreline curves away behind her. Clear tropical sunlight illuminates the gown's raised folds and casts her shadow through the ripples; water reflections scatter across her ankles.
